name: check
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && bun test core/count-ranges.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/count-recovery/row-cases.test.ts research/track-m/section15-derive-order.test.ts

name: audit
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && for f in receipts/*.json.gz; do echo INPUT="$f"; bun research/track-m/audit-lane-b-cost.ts "$f" receipts/family.json || exit; done
